title: Text: DET Tom Moore ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Did Ron talk to you about Campos story?
Yes, how long are you in the DR for?
Whenever you have some time to talk for background, let me know. Just trying to get my ducks in a row, don’t know much about him.
Sounds good. Are you following the team tomorrow?
No, I’m still up north, so I’m free whenever.
Ok, sounds good. I should have some time in the morning tomorrow if that works for you.
That works. Shoot me a text when you’re available. Thank you
